shortDefinition: AI-generated data created to train other AI models or test systems, rather than using real-world data.
fullDefinition: Synthetic data is data generated by AI or other computational methods rather than collected from real-world events. It is used to train AI models when real data is scarce, expensive, or raises privacy concerns. For example, a medical AI might train on synthetic patient records rather than real patient data. AI labs increasingly use AI-generated data to scale training beyond available human-labeled datasets.
